name: Windsurf
shortDescription: AI-first agentic IDE developed by Codeium with deep codebase context, Cascade agent, and multi-file editing capabilities.
description: Windsurf is an AI-first integrated development environment (IDE) developed by Codeium. Built on top of VS Code, Windsurf introduces AI Flows, enabling synchronized human-AI collaboration and autonomous code manipulation. Its AI agent, Cascade, maintains real-time context of large repositories, executes terminal actions, performs multi-file refactoring, and resolves build and runtime errors.

pricing.details: Free plan includes unlimited fast completions and monthly prompt quotas; Pro tier starts at $10/mo for enhanced Cascade usage.

features: Cascade AI agent for deep multi-file codebase understanding and execution
AI Flows for seamless transition between autonomous AI edits and human guidance
Integrated terminal execution for automated command execution and debugging
Real-time intelligent code completion and context indexing across local repositories
useCases: Refactoring multi-file modules and architectures with full codebase context
Accelerating feature creation and bug fixes via agentic terminal feedback loops
limitations: Requires installing a dedicated desktop application rather than an extension
High-tier Cascade prompt limits are capped under free tiers during peak demand
